# CenterMint

Independent iPhone card-centering measurement tool. Recognition runs on device. Optional correction sharing is off by default; eligible future corrected samples upload automatically after opt-in. Centering is not a complete grade and detection is not guaranteed for every design.

- [Product](https://zhao73.github.io/centermint/)
- [日本語](https://zhao73.github.io/centermint/ja/)
- [Calculator](https://zhao73.github.io/centermint/calculator/)
- [Measurement guide](https://zhao73.github.io/centermint/guides/measure-card-centering/)
- [Full-art references](https://zhao73.github.io/centermint/guides/full-art-borders/)
- [Privacy](https://zhao73.github.io/centermint/privacy.html)

Maintained by JIAPENG Zhao. Updated September 9, 2026.
